text:
maria: NexaSupply just sent an update — partial RMA for H100 batch. They can ship 3 units air next week, rest by sea in 2–3 weeks. Need decision: accept split shipment and cover expedite delta? :thinking_face:
ash: Which serials and how many are DOA vs replacement?
maria: Vendor list below (prelim):
```
AWB: NL1234567890 - S/N: H100-AX12, H100-AX13, H100-AX14 (3 units) - AIR
AWB: NL2234567890 - S/N: H100-AX15..AX30 (16 units) - SEA
```
tom: Depot FYI — we have capacity for 5 units arriving Mon, then congestion spikes mid-week. If air lands Mon we can process 3 priority customers same day.
kayla: Suggest we prioritize SLA customers (Acme, Beamstack). Depot can hold remainder in secure cage; queue time ~10d after next week.
henry: What's the vendor price delta for air? Need to model cost vs customer SLA credits.
maria: Vendor quoted +$1,200/unit for air expedite (door-to-door, insurance included). They also offered a contingent credit if DOA rate >3% on replacements.
nash: We need LOA for replacements to preserve warranty chain. Vendor must provide replacement manifest mapping old->new serials. No loose serials.
ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance: provisioning pipeline will have a short window Tue 03:30–04:00 UTC; any incoming manifests after 03:00 may be delayed.
kayla: Customs note — EU HS code for these units differs if shipped as RMA vs new sale. That can add VAT/duties if customs classifies as 'sale'. Who owns reclassification risk?
maria: I'll ask NexaSupply to confirm HS and include commercial invoice marked RMA. I'll also loop in legal for a quick sign-off.
tracking-bot: AWB NL1234567890 accepted by carrier; est arrival FRA 2026-04-05 07:30 UTC.
tom: Routing preference: FRA for EU split and SFO for NA. If vendor can route FRA for the air, customs pre-alert is easier.
henry: Agreed on FRA. Also run quick PO delta: if we expedite 3 units = +$3.6k, compare to SLA credits for 3 customers. I'll calc and post later.
maria: Decision proposal: accept split — expedite 3 units (air) for priority customers, rest SEA. Conditions: vendor provides mapping manifest, revised invoice (air delta broken out), and pre-alert 48h before arrival. 
ash: +1 on manifest requirement. Please capture in amendment.
kayla: :thumbsup: Depot ops will reserve 3 intake slots Mon morning.
maria: I'll send PO amendment and request revised invoice now. Vendor rep @nexasupply to confirm manifest and HS classification.
tracking-bot: Noted: manifest pending. I'll notify when carrier provides final AWB notes.
maria: Closing — action items: 1) maria send PO amendment, 2) vendor provide mapping + HS confirmation, 3) henry posts cost delta analysis. I'll follow up in thread. :white_check_mark:
